instruments.measures: Next-input CE on held-out games. Preflight 'held-out' was train-fit (GOTCHA #122); never compare across label delays (delay-0 leak makes val optimistic).

instruments.measures: Selection vs capacity vs data headroom offline; valid only for pass@k gaps and checkpoint comparisons, never for ranking decodes.

instruments.measures: Dense impulse pathologies of generalist decodes; d_up/min is the reproducible axis.

instruments.measures: Offline behavioral distance to expert by situation; approach_delta sign (retreat vs approach).

instruments.measures: Habit drift of search/PPO arms vs the prior (short-hop, lightshield, grabs...); zoo signatures (roll-grab-bthrow).

instruments.name: Sim win rate vs frozen prior / held-out opponent head
instruments.measures: PPO strength; frozen-ditto gate saturates at 100%; held-out opponent de-saturates (66%).

instruments.name: Sim closed-loop suite: coherence scoreboard, fidelity scorecard, recovery drill, DecisionMap, SilenceMap, recovery_curve_row (decided return / carried died / carried side-B)
instruments.measures: Batched melee-sim-light rollouts; the three bars (return >=0.75, carried-off died <=0.60, carried side-B <=5 per 155 eps). Roll noise: return ±0.02.

instruments.name: Live look (Bradley) + live_scorecard / sd_review / death_classifier / tech_report / punish_quality
instruments.measures: The human gate; live instruments on the .slp of the session (fidelity, death kinds, tech rate, OOS options).

instruments.name: CycleSim
instruments.measures: Dolphin-free full-cycle multishine simulator; cannot score queue-embed lineages.

lessons: Never crown on stand-dummy numbers; rank by chain strength at the DEPLOY rung (ms_g6_sp1: dummy record, zero shines vs a human — overfit to the frozen dummy).
Never deploy at an untrained delay-id (id4 untrained → bare d4 collapses chaining; override to 3).
The eval opponent is part of the input distribution — never compare across dummies; YS claims need n>=8 run-level buckets.
Chain skill lives on transient peaks; final loss anti-correlates with behavior → gate-sweep every epoch; run-to-run variance dominates knobs (replicates first).
Delay-0 LABEL LEAK (GOTCHA #113): Slippi records the input on the frame it produced; delay-0 training learns to continue states, never initiate. Labels are now causal by construction.

Drill delayed labels were the recorded future (policy's own broken trajectory), not the expert's — every DAgger round since g19 trained against conflicts; fixed by phase-indexed label_ahead, off-loop labels DROP (hold loses).
Exposure bias / absorbing states (crouch absorber): one frame of slip lands in unseen states; coverage (synth, DAgger from own rollouts) is the lever, not features.
Mode-seeking decodes die live (argmax buttons, mode-of-N ×2, critic argmax selector) — L9, do not retest; sample at T=1.0.
Mix damage is invisible to teacher-forced metrics; val and the recovery tail are decoupled — gate epochs on closed-loop rows, not val.
Labels off the policy manifold teach the teacher's habits (random-program oracle failed fingerprint); policy-guided search + control arm + fingerprint gate.
Every retrain carries ALL validated mixes; preserve absolute shares (dilution regressed convC3); declare a new round for a new budget.
Count a weighting arm's dose before launching (edge-window arm lifted 9 presses).
Port/opponent corpus bugs (#107, E1): 43% of fox_gen_v1 demos were the opponent; always --select-character-port with opponent remap.
Frozen-ditto PPO win rate saturates; an opponent pool and a human are the honest tests; 100% = exploit shape.
Harness rung law: suite --response-delay = id+2; one knob --reaction-delay k everywhere; run a known-pass control before reading a new harness.
Pre-register predictions; sync pools cannot measure offense (async is the offense rung); no mix during any live beam.
